fields.subject: Resilient Command Execution
fields.trigger: the three-value output-parameter-or-column read finds a matching output parameter for one of the up to three requested value names, and that parameter's value is null or DBNull
fields.response: return null (default) for that value when its requested type can hold null (a reference type or Nullable<T>); otherwise, for a non-nullable value type, throw an UnexpectedSqlResultException whose message names the query and the missing value's requested name
